prompt.en: Why are public awareness and training as important as the technology in a tsunami early warning system? Answer in two or three sentences.

label.en: A warning helps only if the person who receives it knows how to respond.

level1.en: Think about the last person in the chain, who is standing on the shore when the phone rings.

clue.en: People who cannot interpret a warning cannot act on it, so officials and coastal communities are trained.

level2Template.en: A warning helps only if the person who receives it ___.

label.en: Training is itself a part of the system, called capacity development.

level1.en: One part of the system is about people rather than machines. What is it called?

clue.en: This part trains officials and coastal communities.

level2Template.en: Such training is part of the system, under the name ___.

text.en: A tsunami early warning system has two halves: the machines that detect the wave and send the alert, and the people who receive the alert and act on it.
A warning helps only if the person who receives it ___.
Such training is part of the system, under the name ___.

explanation.en: An alert helps only if people understand it and know how to respond. So training officials and communities, called capacity development, is part of the system.
